summary: Dynasty civ that builds both landmarks of an age to unlock bonuses. Song Dynasty speeds up villager production, and Imperial Officials collect tax gold. Very strong late with gunpowder.

spikes.label: Song Dynasty boom
spikes.detail: Building both Feudal landmarks puts them in the Song Dynasty and speeds up villager production.
spikes.answer: If you see two Feudal landmarks, they are greedy. Hit them early.

spikes.label: Zhuge Nu and Nest of Bees
spikes.detail: Zhuge Nus shred light units and Nest of Bees siege deals huge area damage in Castle Age.
spikes.answer: Spread out, and send cavalry to snipe the Nest of Bees.

spikes.label: Gunpowder and Grenadiers
spikes.detail: Grenadiers and handcannons make their Imperial army one of the strongest in the game.
spikes.answer: Close the game before Imperial or out-tech them in the late game.

scout: Two Feudal landmarks means Song Dynasty and a boom
Barbican of the Sun means a defensive, fast Castle plan
Many villagers being produced from more than one Town Center

pairings.why: Fast-firing crossbows behind cheap spearmen in Feudal.
Area gunpowder damage with strong melee in front late game.

winConditions.detail: Outboom through Song Dynasty villagers and tax gold.
